name: Touch of Venice
description: A family-owned Italian restaurant on Main Road in Cutchogue with a full bar, where solo players and small bands perform at the bar on Friday evenings.

dancing.notes: Music is played in the bar area of a sit-down restaurant, usually Fridays from 6 to 9 PM, with acts like The Libations and Earthtones. We found no dance floor and no reports of dancing; expect dinner with background live music.

evidence.note: Official site: Friday night live music at the bar, 6-9 PM, with a July to September 2026 lineup; full bar and dinner service.
Local directory entry mentions live music every Friday night from 6 to 9 PM and a private party room.
Copies of the restaurant's 2026 social posts announce solo and duo acts playing at the bar on Friday nights.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05): a venue in local bands' gig lists.
